capabilities: Summarize PDF slide decks into per-slide Markdown notes
Convert slide equations into inline and display LaTeX
Crop and embed LLM-selected figures from rendered slides
Configure multiple LLM providers including local Ollama
Auto-summarize PDFs added to the vault
disambiguation: Not a presentation tool like the Slides core feature; it reads PDF slide decks and writes study notes from them.
extras: Not yet accepted into the Obsidian community plugin directory (submission in progress); install via BRAT or manually from GitHub releases. API keys are stored in the plugin's data.json inside the vault, and slide text and images are sent to the configured provider.
problem: Turning lecture slide PDFs into usable study notes by hand is slow, and Obsidian has no built-in way to extract per-slide notes, equations and figures from a PDF.

relations.evidence: BRAT installs plugins straight from a GitHub repo and keeps them updated.

requires.name: LLM provider API key (Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic, or custom endpoint)

summary: LLM-powered tool that converts PDF slide decks into Markdown study notes with LaTeX equations and cropped, LLM-selected figures.
